question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

A city on a hill ______ be hidden.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**cannot**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb "**cannot**" is used to denote that something is not possible.
 
• In the context of the sentence, "**A city on a hill cannot be hidden**" suggests that a city situated on a hill is visible and cannot be concealed.
